blocks.source: ｸﾘｱ日
blocks.translation: Clear Date

blocks.source: 筆者のプレイ時間は本編５５時間＋後日談１５時間の合わせて７０時間程度。サブイベントは大体見たが、隠しダンジョンは時間が掛かりそうだったので、未クリア。
blocks.translation: The author played for approximately 70 hours in total: 55 hours for the main story and 15 hours for the epilogue. I saw most of the side events, but did not clear the optional dungeon because it looked like it would take too long.

blocks.source: 質量／物語
blocks.translation: Weight / Story

blocks.source: 物語は幼年期と青年期に分かれた２部構成という形式を取っている。この構成はDQ5等でお馴染みだが外れがない。青年期では、幼馴染や弟との再会などの展開で話を盛り上げる。ただ、幼年期～青年期で再会までのくだりは、もう少し間を持たせても良かった気はする。物語上は７年経過でも、プレイヤー視点では数十分なので感慨も何もという感じではある。
blocks.translation: The story is structured in two parts, divided into childhood and adolescence. This structure is familiar from games like DQ5, but it rarely fails. During adolescence, the story builds excitement through developments such as reunions with childhood friends and a younger brother. That said, I feel the transition from childhood to adolescence, up to the reunions, could have been given a little more breathing room. Although seven years pass in the story, only a few dozen minutes pass from the player's perspective, so it is hard to feel much emotion about it.

blocks.source: ストーリー展開はとても王道。プレイヤーの予想を大きく覆す様なドンデン返しこそないが、安定した作り。キャラクターの掘り下げも丁寧。その分、心情描写がしつこいので面倒臭く感じるかも。
blocks.translation: The story follows a very classic path. While it has no major twists that completely overturn the player's expectations, it is solidly constructed. The characters are also developed with care. On the other hand, the persistent focus on their feelings may become tedious.

blocks.source: 『未来の系譜編』は本編の半年後の物語。本編と比較すると、テーマ性がはっきりしている。おまけ的な物ではなく、しっかりした作りで後味も良好。
blocks.translation: The “Lineage to the Future Chapter” takes place six months after the main story. Compared with the main story, its themes are clearer. It is not merely an extra; it is well made and leaves a satisfying aftertaste.

blocks.source: ゲーム中盤から終盤まで自由に動ける期間が少なく、結果としてサブイベントが終盤に偏ってしまっている。シリーズ恒例の闘技場もあるけれど、中盤のイベント以降、終盤まで挑戦できるチャンスが回ってこないので、もったいない。
blocks.translation: There is little time to move freely from the middle to the end of the game, and as a result, the side events are concentrated toward the end. The series' traditional arena is also present, but after the mid-game event, you do not get another chance to challenge it until the end, which is a shame.

blocks.source: コスチュームチェンジ（DLC除く）などの遊び要素は、ヴェスペリアと比べると数は少なめ。チャットもストーリーに沿った物がほとんどで、料理や戦闘に関わるような物はほとんどなし。最もこれはグレイセスが手抜きと言うよりも、ヴェスペリアが力が入りすぎていたという方が正しいけれど。
blocks.translation: There are fewer recreational elements, such as costume changes (excluding DLC), than in Vesperia. Most of the skits also follow the story, with very few involving cooking or battles. Though, strictly speaking, this is less a matter of Graces cutting corners and more a matter of Vesperia putting too much effort into these elements.

blocks.source: システム／バランス
blocks.translation: Systems / Balance

blocks.source: シリーズお馴染みのアクション風戦闘。今回はMPの様な概念がなく、戦闘中に自動的に溜まるCCを消費して攻撃を行う。多分、PS2版のデスティニー（筆者未プレイ）に近い仕様のはず。
blocks.translation: The series' familiar action-style battle system. This time, there is no concept like MP; attacks consume CC, which automatically accumulates during battle. It is probably similar to the PS2 version of Destiny (which I have not played).

blocks.source: 攻撃は○と×のボタンによって、２種類にスタイルが分かれる。キャラクターによっては「剣と銃」「武器と術」の様に多彩な攻撃ができるのが面白い。
blocks.translation: Attacks are divided into two styles depending on whether you use the ○ or × button. It is interesting that some characters can perform a wide variety of attacks, such as “sword and gun” or “weapon and artes.”

blocks.source: ヴェスペリアでは過剰に多い装備品によるスキル習得システムを採用していたが、今回は称号によるスキル習得システムに変更。オート設定にすれば、スキル習得をする度に、自動的に別の称号に変更してくれるので、ある程度は手間が減った。
blocks.translation: Vesperia used a skill-learning system based on its excessively large number of pieces of equipment, but this time it has been changed to a system based on titles. With the auto setting enabled, your title is automatically changed whenever you learn a skill, reducing the hassle to some extent.

blocks.source: とはいえ、称号やスキルの数が多くて煩雑なのは相変わらず。『特定の術の詠唱時間を４％短縮する』という様な効果の小さいスキルがたくさんあるが、戦闘が非常に派手なので、そういうチマチマとした差を実感するのは難しい。個人的には数をもっと絞って効果を高めた方がメリハリが付いて良いかと思う。
blocks.translation: Even so, the large number of titles and skills remains cumbersome. There are many skills with minor effects, such as “reduces the casting time of a specific arte by 4%,” but battles are so flashy that it is difficult to notice such small differences. Personally, I think it would be better to narrow down the number of skills and increase their effects to give them more distinction.

blocks.source: アイテムの種類も非常に多い。合成（デュアライズ）のシステムが存在するが、ルールは複雑。手に入れた武器防具は合成で強化することができるが、新しく武器防具が手に入った場合、強化分を引き継げ無いのでやり辛い。これはプレイヤー心理的にちょっと嫌な仕様だと感じた。
blocks.translation: There are also a great many types of items. The synthesis (Dualize) system is present, but its rules are complex. Weapons and armor you obtain can be enhanced through synthesis, but when you acquire new equipment, the enhancements cannot be carried over, making the system difficult to use. I found this to be a somewhat unpleasant design from the player's perspective.

blocks.source: システムは全般的に複雑なのだが、戦闘では、○ボタンを連打していれば、それなりに技が出るので、初心者でも何とかなるはず。メニュー画面を開けばシステムの詳細な説明を読むこともできる。でも、シリーズ初心者がいきなりこんな複雑なシステムを見せられたら、普通はちょっと引くんじゃないかと気掛かり。
blocks.translation: The systems are complicated overall, but in battle, beginners should be able to manage because repeatedly pressing the ○ button will still produce various techniques. You can also read detailed explanations of the systems by opening the menu. Still, I worry that a series newcomer might be put off if they are suddenly presented with such a complicated system.

blocks.source: シリーズの例に漏れず戦闘の難易度設定が可能。ただし、難易度を下げると敵のレベルが下がる。PS3版では、敵のレベルがこちらより低いと経験値が大きく下がる仕様が存在するので、本当に優しくなっているのかどうかは疑問。筆者は隠しダンジョンについては難易度を下げてサクッとやろうとしたのだが、敵の経験値まで下がっていることに気付いて断念した。この仕様はライトユーザーに優しくないと思う。
blocks.translation: As with other entries in the series, you can set the battle difficulty. However, lowering the difficulty also lowers the enemies' levels. In the PS3 version, enemy experience points are greatly reduced when their level is lower than yours, so it is questionable whether the game is truly becoming easier. I tried lowering the difficulty to quickly get through the optional dungeon, but gave up when I realized that the enemies' experience points were reduced as well. I do not think this design is friendly to casual players.

blocks.source: 快適性
blocks.translation: Playability

blocks.source: この時代のRPGにしては快適な部類。戦闘はこのシリーズらしくスピーディ。シンボルエンカウントだが、それほど敵の数は多くないし、ロードなども気にならない。戦闘前の長いイベントなど、きちんと『START+△』ボタンでカットできる様になっている。
blocks.translation: It is relatively comfortable to play for an RPG of its era. Battles are fast-paced, as one would expect from this series. Although it uses symbol encounters, there are not that many enemies, and loading times are not bothersome. Long events before battles can also be properly skipped with the “START + △” buttons.

blocks.source: ただし、このシリーズらしく、サブイベントまで網羅しようとすると面倒も多い。特に一度クリアしたダンジョンの奥に再度行かせるのは止めて欲しい。面白いイベントも多いので、サクッとやれるようにして欲しかった。
blocks.translation: However, as is typical of this series, trying to cover all the side events involves a lot of hassle. In particular, I wish it would stop sending you back to the depths of dungeons you have already cleared. There are many interesting events, so I wish they could have been completed more quickly.

blocks.source: 後半のダンジョンは長く、敵も強くなるので時間が掛かるようになる。元々の本編だけでも十分な時間が掛かるが、その上に後日談が追加されているので、長ったるく感じるかもしれない。
blocks.translation: The later dungeons are long, and the enemies become stronger, so they take more time. The main story alone already takes a considerable amount of time, and with the epilogue added on top, the game may feel overly long.

blocks.source: 細かいことだが、町人との会話時に振り向き等の動作が入るのが面倒。このゲームは多くの人物が２回話しかけると内容が変わるので、このちょっとした間が気になる。というか、大した事を話すわけでも無いのに会話を２回に分ける意味が不明。確かこれはヴェスペリアも同じ。
blocks.translation: This is a minor issue, but it is tedious that townspeople turn around and perform other motions during conversations. Many people in this game change what they say when you talk to them a second time, so these brief pauses become noticeable. In fact, I do not understand why conversations are split into two exchanges when they do not even say anything particularly important. I believe Vesperia did the same thing.

blocks.source: 美術
blocks.translation: Art

blocks.source: ヴェスペリアとあまり変わらない印象だが、変にリアル路線を目指すよりは良いと思う。やはり、このシリーズの戦闘には華がある。特にグレイセスの秘奥義はスピーディで爽快感あるアニメーションに仕上げてあるのが好印象。
blocks.translation: It gives much the same impression as Vesperia, but I think that is better than oddly pursuing a realistic style. As expected, battles in this series have a certain flair. In particular, Graces' Mystic Artes are presented as speedy, exhilarating animations, which is a strong point.

blocks.source: 音楽
blocks.translation: Music

blocks.source: いつものテイルズと違って、ダンジョン曲が地味め。後半のダンジョンから、ようやく気合の入った曲が流れ出す。戦闘曲は賑やかな効果音やボイスに隠れがちながら、それなりの水準。
blocks.translation: Unlike typical Tales games, the dungeon themes are rather subdued. It is not until the later dungeons that truly energetic music finally begins to play. The battle themes tend to be drowned out by the lively sound effects and voices, but are still of a reasonable standard.

lines.source: 元々はWiiで発売されたテイルズオブグレイセスのPS3移植＋追加版。追加シナリオとして、後日談の『未来の系譜編』が存在する。 追加シナリオのプレイ時間は１５時間程度と結構な規模。[[LINK_1]]ヴェスペリア[[/LINK_1]](XBOX→PS3)に引き続き、相変わらずの完全版商法。

parts.source: 元々はWiiで発売されたテイルズオブグレイセスのPS3移植＋追加版。追加シナリオとして、後日談の『未来の系譜編』が存在する。 追加シナリオのプレイ時間は１５時間程度と結構な規模。
(XBOX→PS3)に引き続き、相変わらずの完全版商法。

lines.translation: Originally released for the Wii, this is a PS3 port and expanded version of Tales of Graces. An additional scenario, the epilogue “Future Lineage Chapter,” is included. With a playtime of around 15 hours, the additional scenario is quite substantial. Following [[LINK_1]]Vesperia[[/LINK_1]] (XBOX→PS3), it’s the same old definitive-edition sales strategy.
